about.title: Who I
about.bio1: Hey there! I'm Eslam Awod — a Full-Stack Developer with 2+ years building production-ready web applications and AI-powered systems. I've shipped 6+ real projects from scratch, ranging from restaurant POS systems to algorithmic crypto trading bots.
about.bio2: My stack covers the full spectrum: pixel-perfect UIs with React 19 and Next.js, robust REST APIs with Laravel & Sanctum, and real-time backend services with Node.js. I've handled Clover POS integrations, QR-based ordering systems, multi-role RBAC platforms, and AI/ML trading algorithms.
about.bio3: I thrive on turning complex technical challenges into clean, maintainable solutions. Whether it's a startup MVP or a scaling production system — I bring both technical depth and product thinking to every project.
